newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarb Debica seeks Aug 29 listing.
newsitem.headline: Polifarb Debica seeks Aug 29 listing.

text.p: Polish paint maker Polifarb Debica SA, 32-percent owned by Swedish Alcro-Beckers AB, has proposed to the Warsaw bourse that it start trade on August 29, Polifarb said in a statement on Friday.
The company's February initial public offering of 0.7 million shares at 65 zlotys each was heavily oversubscribed.

Last month the Swedish firm, then holding a 0.3-percent stake in Polifarb, called a public tender offer to buy the remaining 2,029,436 shares at 89 zlotys from July 25-August 22. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
